title: Shipping a Gen AI Feature: Capstone
description: Combine prompting, tools, retrieval, and evaluation into one deployed feature end to end.
learningOutcomes: Design a Gen AI feature from requirements to production
Wire an LLM feature into a FastAPI backend
Ship with evaluation, guardrails, and cost controls in place

lessons.title: Specifying the Feature
lessons.description: Turn a vague product idea into a testable Gen AI feature spec.
learningObjectives: Write acceptance criteria for an LLM feature
Decide what must be deterministic vs. model-driven
Scope a capstone to something shippable

lessons.title: Wiring It into a FastAPI Backend
lessons.description: Expose the feature as a real, tested API endpoint.
learningObjectives: Add a streaming or synchronous LLM endpoint
Reuse Pydantic models as the output contract
Handle provider errors as proper HTTP responses

lessons.title: Hardening for Production
lessons.description: Add the guardrails, evals, and monitoring the earlier modules covered.
learningObjectives: Wire in the eval set before shipping
Add rate limiting and cost caps
Add logging for every model call

lessons.title: Capstone Review and Next Steps
lessons.description: Review the finished feature against the original spec.
learningObjectives: Check the feature against acceptance criteria
Identify the next improvement worth making
Connect this project to the AI/ML track
